workloads.phaseBoundary: Do not start interaction until the post-orbit full-quality render completes. Drain all submissions between phases under existing operation/suite bounds. Phase-local issuance uses absolute targets; waiting never restarts a request latency clock.

stress.valueRule: even edit indices use alternate; odd indices use base; final edit restores base

settled.trigger: automatic settle after the final issued orbit pose
settled.start: creation of that settled request, observed in the page
settled.stop: first complete full-resolution geometry, normals and direct-light publication
settled.fullQuality: record separately and finish before interaction

warmup.procedure: Prepare, then run and record the complete workload. No discarded warm-up trial. Before each later attempt restore the frozen base scene and overview pose and drain outstanding work outside the timed phases; never reload the page.

coverageCheckpoints.comparison: rayTermination counts at the frozen poses versus B04 predictions; timed checkpoint requests may be superseded
coverageCheckpoints.timedPublications: Every counted timed publication must match its request identity and quality and contain the complete internal pixel count; selected timed requests may be superseded.
coverageCheckpoints.settledMeaning: Replay of the first settled direct-light image, sample 0. The timed request remains full lighting with targetSamples 8; its full-quality milestone is recorded separately.

timing.firstSettledImage: full-resolution geometry, normals and direct light at settled iteration and tracing settings
timing.visibleOutput: Headed screenshots of the settled-first replay at each scene, outside the timed workload.

classification.applicationFailure: failed regardless of timing anomalies; any established application target failure prevents scene acceptance
classification.harnessFailure: excluded only with demonstrated harness failure and no established application target failure
classification.coverage: failed or missing coverage cannot satisfy a target

materialization.overviewRule: 2.5 times the enclosing radius along normalized Project 0 A.6 direction; upright, focusLocal [0,0,0]
materialization.workloadHash: SHA-256 of final manifest bytes recorded externally in the B04 handoff and B15 report; never self-embedded
materialization.predictionHash: SHA-256 of prediction artifact bytes stored in predictionArtifact.sha256; predictions do not embed the manifest hash
